Class Dependency

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.runner.build.Dependency
public final class Dependency extends Object
One dependency to nest into the runner jar, together with the coordinates it was resolved from.

Four things about a dependency determine the archive, and a plugin's cache key must cover all four:

  • the file's bytes, which are nested as they are or repacked uncompressed;
  • its file name, which becomes the nested entry's name;
  • its coordinates, which are written into the index so that inspect and any tool reading a runner jar can tell which module a nested jar came from;
  • its position in RunnerJarSpec.dependencies(), which is the class path order.

The builder nests a file that is a ZIP archive, fails on a directory, and skips any other file with a warning. Build systems that can resolve coordinates (Gradle from ResolvedArtifactResult, Maven from the project artifacts) should pass them; a file dependency that has none uses of(Path).

A dependency is an immutable value: two dependencies with the same path and coordinates are equal.

Since:
1.0
